NOTES TO CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
(In millions, except per share data)

Note 12 - Commitments and Contingencies

As of July 26, 2026, we had outstanding inventory purchase and long-term supply and capacity obligations totaling $279 billion, compared with $95.2 billion as of January 25, 2026. In certain instances, these agreements are cancelable, rescheduled, or adjustable for our business needs prior to placement of firm orders.

Of these obligations, $92 billion is due in the remainder of fiscal year 2027 and $87 billion in fiscal year 2028.

Purchase obligations increased by $183.8 billion during the first half of fiscal year 2027.

We could be required to pay up to $2.0 billion under our purchase commitments if we cancel orders after the cut-off dates.
